_comment: Headline coverage figures: the only file to edit for them. The homepage, docs/coverage and llms.txt read it at build time. A value left as its own {{NAME}} token renders as a visible placeholder; `npm run build` warns, and `npm run check:figures` fails, while any is left.
_sources: The syntax figures come from `cargo run --release -p sqlquack-syntax-coverage -- summary` on main, which counts the catalogue against the auditor's review records in coverage/syntax/reviews, not from coverage/syntax/baseline.json, which is bound to an older catalogue. SYNTAX_FORMS is that count's denominator and SYNTAX_PCT its verified share. TRANSLATION_PCT is the share of actual Snowflake statements that convert in full.
